headline: Which law firms advised Turtlemint on its ₹882.67 crore IPO?

detail: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited listed its equity shares on the NSE and BSE on June 29 after its ₹882.67 crore initial public offering. Turtlemint is a tech-enabled insurance distribution platform that connects customers, insurance advisors and insurers. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Turtlemint and its investor selling shareholders on the IPO, while A&O Shearman acted as sole international legal counsel to the underwriters. The SAM transaction team advising Turtlemint was led by Partners Nikhil Naredi and Krupa Brahmbhatt , with support from Senior Associate Anoushka PV and Associate Dhanashree Singe.
